plan.name: Keep local paths out of the factory's error text
plan.summary: A new localPaths(text, work) in internal/factory/localpaths.go rewrites the paths on this machine in free-form text. A path under the watcher's work directory (Factory.Work) becomes relative to it, so a build's result directory reads issue-91/build-20260929-101010/result. Any other absolute path becomes its last part, so /Users/someone/.local/bin/claude reads claude, while URLs, branch names, the repository's own paths and commands such as `/invariant retry` stay as they are. The factory passes the text it gets from a run through it before saving it under refs/invariant/runs/ or posting it: a build's error and its review, for a project or a plan, a plan build's summary, which quotes its agent run's error, and a draft's problem, whether the formalizer's own or its run's error. So a failure comment, a pull request and a saved record still say what failed and where, and no longer quote an absolute path or any part of the work directory's own path, as #91's comment did.

tests.name: TestLocalPathsInErrorText
tests.says: In error text, a path under the work directory is written relative to it and any other absolute path as its last part, while URLs, branch names, the repository's own paths and the factory's commands stay as they are.

tests.name: TestABuildThatCantRunNamesNoLocalPath
tests.says: A build whose agent run fails with no result, as #91's did when its final gate couldn't run, gets a failure comment that says what failed and where, relative to the work directory, and names no absolute path from the error and no part of the work directory's own path.

tests.name: TestABuildsSavedErrorNamesNoLocalPath
tests.says: A build whose agent run fails after its final gate ran gets a failure comment, and a saved record under refs/invariant/runs/ whose error says what failed and where, and neither names an absolute path from the error or any part of the work directory's own path.

tests.name: TestAPlanBuildThatCantRunNamesNoLocalPath
tests.says: A plan's build that fails with no result gets a failure comment that says what failed and where, and names no absolute path from the error and no part of the work directory's own path.

tests.name: TestAPlanBuildsErrorsNameNoLocalPath
tests.says: A plan's build whose agent run ended with an error, and whose review didn't run, gets a failure comment, a pull request and a saved record that say what failed and where, and name no absolute path from the errors and no part of the work directory's own path.

tests.name: TestADraftsProblemNamesNoLocalPath
tests.says: A draft whose problem names a path under the work directory gets a comment and a saved record that say what went wrong and where, and name no absolute path from the problem and no part of the work directory's own path.
